name: 261. Converse additionalModelRequestFields prompt_cache_options reaches the outbound request (converse prompt cache mode)
description: Since #8334/#8322 Bifrost leaves gpt-5.6 requests in the default implicit prompt cache mode when it translates a cache marker, so a Converse cachePoint after the system prompt no longer limits caching to the system prompt. OpenAI documents prompt_cache_options.mode explicit as the opt-in for breakpoint-only caching, and explicit with no breakpoints as caching off. The AWS SDK ConverseInput has no field for it, so a /bedrock drop-in caller can only send it inside additionalModelRequestFields. BedrockConverseRequest.ToBifrostResponsesRequest (core/providers/bedrock/responses.go) never read that key, so the outbound Responses body had no prompt_cache_options. Each case sends prompt_cache_options {mode: explicit} in additionalModelRequestFields and reads the logged raw_request to assert the outbound body carries mode explicit and the expected number of prompt_cache_breakpoint markers (1 with a system cachePoint, 0 without). Red before the fix: raw_request has no prompt_cache_options. The Go-level pin is TestConverseAdditionalModelRequestFieldsPromptCacheOptionsReachesParams.

item.name: 261.1 /bedrock converse -> azure/gpt-5.6-luna system cachePoint plus prompt_cache_options explicit reaches outbound body (converse prompt cache mode)

exec: pm.test('converse cache mode azure: request succeeded', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text().slice(0, 500)).to.eql(200); });
var reqId = pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-request-id');
pm.test('converse cache mode azure: x-bifrost-request-id echoed', function () { pm.expect(reqId, 'x-bifrost-request-id header').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
// raw_request is the body Bifrost sent upstream. The log row is written by the batching writer and,
// for streams, filled in when the stream ends, so poll until it parses. Bounded: ten reads a second apart.
// It may be stored as a JSON string of the JSON body, so unwrap up to twice.
function rawOf(j) { var rr = j.raw_request; for (var i = 0; i < 2 && typeof rr === 'string'; i++) { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } } return rr; }
function checkLog(attempt) {
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
var rr = (!err && res.code === 200) ? rawOf(res.json()) : null;
if (rr && typeof rr === 'object') {
var dump = JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 800);

pm.test('converse cache mode azure: outbound body carries prompt_cache_options.mode explicit', function () { pm.expect(rr.prompt_cache_options, 'prompt_cache_options missing from outbound raw_request (request stays in implicit mode): ' + dump).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(rr.prompt_cache_options.mode, dump).to.eql('explicit'); });
pm.test('converse cache mode azure: outbound body carries 1 prompt_cache_breakpoint', function () { pm.expect(JSON.stringify(rr).split('"prompt_cache_breakpoint"').length - 1, dump).to.eql(1); });
return;
if (attempt < 10) { setTimeout(function () { checkLog(attempt + 1); }, 1000); return; }

pm.test('converse cache mode azure: raw_request logged', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' never carried a parseable raw_request: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text().slice(0, 500)))); });
if (reqId) { checkLog(0); }
